long_biography.plain_text:
Two unfinished apartment projects in Nashville helped keep Marc Padgett’s young contracting company alive during the financial crisis. The original builder had lost its bond, creating an opening for Summit Contracting Group to complete the work when new construction had nearly stopped.

Padgett built the operating model around multifamily projects and repeat clients. His experience as a sprinkler installer, superintendent, estimator and project manager informs direct oversight of contract negotiations, pre-construction planning and value engineering. Summit works across market-rate, affordable, senior and student housing, with Padgett remaining president and a member of its active Florida operating entities.
